sources.author: byehi98
patch_list: Removes all ads: ad service, house-ad network, ad rows, polling, and banner/popup surfaces; disables cloud boot pages, cloud prompts, and the help-center robot.
Bypasses anti-emulator self-kill and disables analytics, telemetry, device-ID, and crash-reporting SDKs.
Blocks all app update and force-update dialogs and their version checks.
Hides the in-app rating dialog and rate-us tip banner.
Unlocks cloud/WeChat-call entitlements, extends alarm replay duration and message window, and disables 4G trial countdown gates. - Doesn't unlock Cloud Server Side Storage.
